DELETE /api/admin/hotels/{id} - successfully deletes hotel without active bookings
DELETE /api/admin/hotels/{id} - correctly blocks deletion when hotel has active bookings

GET /api/admin/import/batches - returns import history with batch names, imported/skipped counts
